January 28, 2026

For release at 2:00 p.m. EST

The Committee judges that economic activity has continued to expand at a steady pace. Job gains remain solid.

The Committee seeks to achieve maximum employment and inflation at the rate of 2 percent over the longer run. The Committee decided to maintain the target range for the policy rate.

Voting for the FOMC monetary policy action were: Alice Example, Chair; Bob Sample, Vice Chair; Carol Demo. Voting against the action was Dan Placeholder, who preferred to lower the target range by 25 basis points.

For media inquiries, see Implementation Note issued January 28, 2026
